readerCopy.summary: A work of art, testimony, or sustained investigation brings hidden suffering into public view without reducing it to a spectacle.
readerCopy.body: A work of art, testimony, or sustained investigation brings hidden suffering into public view without reducing it to a spectacle. The story names the systems, money, and private decisions shaping the harm while preserving the humanity of the people living through it. Neptune carries empathy and imagination, while Pluto exposes control, secrecy, and the deeper structure underneath the visible crisis. Under the trine, emotional truth and difficult evidence reinforce each other without softening what happened. The public response gains depth because compassion is connected to the power that made the harm possible.
